caption:
Every morning Mr Turtle bends over the bathroom sink and his lower back feels stiff. By lunchtime it's mostly fine.

Backs often feel stiffer first thing after waking. Bending forward from the back with straight legs over a low sink can make that stiffness more noticeable.

Hybi's morning routine: walk around for a few minutes first, soften your knees and hinge from the hips, and rest one hand on the bench for support. Knee hugs in bed (10 seconds × 5) can help too.

Pain spreading down a leg, tingling or weakness, or no change after two weeks are worth an assessment. Our chiropractors at Hybrid Physio can help. Book online via the link in bio 🪥
